column1: # Stateless-variant layout for Waveshare ESP32-P4 boards.
# This table is BUILD-TIME scaffolding only: partition-table.bin is never
# flashed for stateless (the signed bundle carries just the app image
# runtime the payload reads the LOADER's table from flash at 0x20000).
# Blank offsets auto-place every partition AFTER the 0x20000 table sector
# the table never overlaps nvs (the failure mode of the pinned-offset 32MiB
# table under CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET=0x20000). Factory keeps the same
# 12 MB size so app-size checks match the flash builds; coredump is dropped
